race: the handler checks `os.path.exists(dest)` (time-of-check) then writes (time-of-use); an attacker swaps the path/ symlink between the two, diverting the write. fix: write to a temp file in the same directory, then `os.rename(tmp, dest)` — rename is atomic on the same filesystem, eliminating the check/use gap. also use `os.open(dest, o_creat|o_excl)` to refuse existing paths.
